title: hub.get Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response containing the current Notehub configuration for the Notecard.

align.description: `true` if syncs are aligned on a regular time-periodic cycle, as set with the `align` argument of `hub.set`.

duration.description: When in `continuous` mode, the session length in minutes, as set with the `duration` argument of `hub.set`.

host.description: The hostname of the Notehub service, as set with the `host` argument of `hub.set`.

inbound.description: The max wait time, in minutes, to sync inbound data from Notehub, as set with the `inbound` argument of `hub.set` (or the default, if not set).

mode.description: The current operating mode of the Notecard, as set with the `mode` argument of `hub.set`.

sub-descriptions.description: Periodically connect to the Notehub. This is the default value set on each Notecard after a factory reset.
Enables an always-on network connection, for high power devices. Outbound data still syncs periodically, unless specified in a Note or File request.
Disables periodic connection. The Notecard will not sync until it receives an explicit `hub.sync` request. OTA DFU updates are not available when using this mode.
Disables automatic and manual syncs. `hub.sync` requests will be ignored in this mode. OTA DFU updates are not available when using this mode.
Puts the Notecard in DFU mode for IAP host MCU firmware updates. This mode is effectively the same as `off` in terms of the Notecard's network and Notehub connections.

outbound.description: The max wait time, in minutes, to sync outbound data from the Notecard, as set with the `outbound` argument of `hub.set` (or the default, if not set).

product.description: The ProductUID to which the Notecard is registered, as set with the `product` argument of `hub.set`.

sn.description: The serial number of the device, as set with the `sn` argument of `hub.set`.

sync.description: `true` if the device is in `continuous` mode and set to sync every time a change is detected, as set with the `sync` argument of `hub.set`.

umin.description: `true` if the Notecard is set to stay in `continuous` mode on USB/line power and fall back to `minimum` mode when USB/line power is disconnected, as set with the `umin` argument of `hub.set`.

uoff.description: `true` if the Notecard is set to stay in `continuous` mode on USB/line power and fall back to `off` mode when USB/line power is disconnected, as set with the `uoff` argument of `hub.set`.

uperiodic.description: `true` if the Notecard is set to stay in `continuous` mode on USB/line power and fall back to `periodic` mode when USB/line power is disconnected, as set with the `uperiodic` argument of `hub.set`.

vinbound.description: The voltage-variable value that overrides `inbound`, as set with the `vinbound` argument of `hub.set`.

voutbound.description: The voltage-variable value that overrides `outbound`, as set with the `voutbound` argument of `hub.set`.
